reason: A better addresses genuinely high-temperature exposure and proposes a plausible competition between protective Al/Cr oxides and Ti-associated scale breakdown, with observable interfacial signatures and falsification criteria. B extrapolates a 400 °C result from a different Mn-containing alloy and incorrectly frames Ni—the least readily oxidized constituent—as a rapidly formed pre-oxide, while its predicted spallation is unsupported at the stated timescale.
